This intent-based marketing is incredibly powerful. When someone searches for "physical therapist near me" or "back pain treatment [your city]," a well-executed Google Ads campaign places your clinic directly in front of them. This leads to higher quality leads and a more efficient marketing spend compared to broader advertising methods.
